name: Drăculești
source:
[i]February 1931. Castle Dracula.[/i]

Since his release from Stone House Asylum, Roger M. Renfield has kept to the continent, handling foreign clients for the Hawkins & Harker law firm and staying as far as he can from England – and the threat of reinstitutionalisation.

A man who’ll take any assignment over returning home, he’s the perfect choice for the job no-one else wants: a trip to remote Transylvania, to sell a house to an eccentric old noble. Only, Prince Dracula isn’t what Renfield expected…

Taken captive by a family of vampires, Renfield must unravel a mystery spanning centuries, and lay the angry spirits of the house to rest. [i]Everyone is trapped here. Everyone needs to be freed.[/i]

Play as Renfield, survive the terror of Castle Dracula, and find love in the darkest night in romantic horror visual novel Drăculești.

[from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1712125696/draculesti]Kickstarter[/url]]
